training_scope: 14 FAIB PSP plots in the 100 Mile House TSA (IDF), with LidarBC 2019/2024 point clouds and plot radius/area matched to FAIB plot headers. First-return metrics above 2 m; live trees DBH >= 9.1 cm.
source: FAIB Forest Inventory Ground Plots (public PSP data, OGL-BC) and LidarBC point clouds (OGL-BC); FEMIC INV-01 pilot fit 2026-10-30.

applicability.notes: 14-plot TSA 23 IDF pilot. LOOCV only; no independent spatial holdout. Not an operational inventory. High-biomass IDF stands above the published predictor range are unsupported; three of four external TSA 23 high-biomass plots are outside the BA/volume range, and one is outside the height range. Do not extrapolate.

caveats: Only 14 TSA 23 IDF plots; all used in LOOCV.
First-return point-cloud metrics, not CHM proxies.
Plot support matched to FAIB plot area/radius.
No independent P48/P49 field validation or spatial holdout.
Do not use for operational TSA 23 planning without more plots and independent validation.
High-biomass IDF stands above the published predictor range are unsupported; the external TSA 23 PSP check was largely out of range.
